cards.ex: The deafening silence after I announced my decision was unnerving.
cards.exUz: Men qarorimni e'lon qilganimdan keyingi jimjitlik juda xavotirli edi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda shovqin bo'lishi kutilgan joyda mutlaq jimlik

cards.ex: You could hear a pin drop during the important announcement.
cards.exUz: Muhim e'londa mutlaq sukunat edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda jim, hatto ignaning tushishi ham eshitiladi

cards.ex: The music was so loud it drowned out our conversation.
cards.exUz: Musiqa shunchalik baland ediki, u suhbatimizni eshitilmay qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Shovqin bilan boshqa tovushni eshitilmaydigan qilish

cards.ex: All I want is a little peace and quiet after a long day at work.
cards.exUz: Ishdan keyin men faqat ozgina tinchlik va osoyishtalikni xohlayman.

cards.ex: I use a white noise machine to help me sleep.
cards.exUz: Men uxlashimga yordam berish uchun oq shovqin mashinasidan foydalanaman.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy, bir xil shovqin, masalan, ventilyatorning ovozi

cards.ex: That name rings a bell, but I can't quite place him.
cards.exUz: Bu ism tanish tuyuladi, lekin uni aniqlay olmayapman.

cards.ex: I didn't hear a peep from the kids all afternoon.
cards.exUz: Men tushdan keyin bolalardan hech qanday ovoz eshitmadim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday ovoz eshitmaslik, umuman jimjitlik

cards.ex: Don't tell him anything, he's such a loudmouth!

cards.ex: The project is very hush-hush, so don't talk about it.
cards.exUz: Loyiha juda maxfiy, shuning uchun u haqida gapirmang.

cards.ex: The car screeched to a halt right in front of me.
cards.exUz: Mashina mening oldimda g'ijirlab to'xtadi.

cards.ex: We're really on the same wavelength when it comes to music.
cards.exUz: Musiqa haqida gap ketganda, biz bir xil fikrdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir-birini tushunish

cards.ex: He was humming and hawing about whether to accept the job.
cards.exUz: U ishni qabul qilish yoki qilmaslik haqida ikkilanayotgan edi.

cards.ex: The news that I got the job was music to my ears.
cards.exUz: Ishga qabul qilinganim haqidagi xabar menga juda yoqimli bo'ldi.

cards.ex: We heard a rumble of thunder in the distance.
cards.exUz: Biz uzoqda momaqaldiroqning gumburlashini eshitdik.

cards.ex: The market was bustling with activity on Saturday morning.
cards.exUz: Shanba kuni ertalab bozor harakat bilan gavjum edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p harakat va shovqin bilan to'la

cards.ex: He's quiet, but still waters run deep.
cards.exUz: U sokin, lekin sokin daryolar chuqur.

cards.ex: The kids were making such a racket in the backyard.
cards.exUz: Bolalar orqa hovlida shunchalik shovqin chiqarishayotgan edi.

cards.ex: I'm completely tone-deaf, I can't sing at all.
cards.exUz: Men butunlay musiqa qobiliyatiga ega emasman, umuman kuylay olmayman.

cards.ex: The kids were quiet as a mouse while their dad was sleeping.
cards.exUz: Bolalar dadasi uxlayotganida sichqondek tinch edilar.

cards.ex: I love listening to the patter of rain on the roof.
cards.exUz: Tomdagi yomg'ir shivirini eshitishni yaxshi ko'raman.

cards.ex: Her voice was as clear as a bell.
cards.exUz: Uning ovozi juda aniq va ravshan edi.

cards.ex: The city was a cacophony of sounds.
cards.exUz: Shahar shovqin aralashmasi edi.

cards.ex: I could hear the gentle hum of the refrigerator.
cards.exUz: Men muzlatgichning mayin g'uvillashini eshitdim.

cards.ex: We heard a piercing shriek from the other room.
cards.exUz: Biz boshqa xonadan o'tkir qichqiriq eshitdik.

cards.ex: I just tune out when he starts complaining.
cards.exUz: U shikoyat qila boshlaganda, men shunchaki e'tibor bermayman.

cards.ex: Bees were buzzing around the flowers.
cards.exUz: Asalarilar gullar atrofida g'ujillab yurishardi.

cards.ex: I heard a dull thud from upstairs.
cards.exUz: Men yuqori qavatdan bo'g'iq zarba ovozini eshitdim.

cards.ex: I love the rustle of leaves in the autumn.
cards.exUz: Men kuzda barglarning shivirini yaxshi ko'raman.

cards.ex: There's no need to raise your voice, I can hear you.
cards.exUz: Ovozingizni ko'tarishga hojat yo'q, men sizni eshitaman.

cards.ex: They spoke in a hushed tone so no one would overhear.
cards.exUz: Ular hech kim eshitmasligi uchun past ovozda gaplashishdi.
